text:
samir patel: FYI team — leadership signed off on a v6 preview pricebook. This is opt-in only and targeted at strategic accounts that want the new "embeddings-pro" SKU and simplified GPU SKUs. Preview will be available Mon 07:00 PT in the staging catalog. HIGH-LEVEL: consolidated embeddings SKUs, small upward adjustment on per-token for low-volume tiers, new 'burst-reserve' SKU deprecated (replaced by dynamic burst pricing). :loudspeaker:

zoe park: timeline? and do we need deal desk approval for customers on signed monthly commits that want to move to preview?

samir patel: timeline: publish preview artifacts Mon 07:00 PT, internal review window Mon 07:0010:00 PT, public opt-in by request starting Tue. For moves mid-commit: annual commits are eligible for auto-grandfathering to keep previous math. Monthly or flex commits require a signed amendment to opt into v6-preview. We'll add clear logic to the amendment template.

taylor reed: can you post the exact SFDC filter for finding impacted opportunities (monthly commits + POCs)? want to surface to AE queue.

samir patel: use this SOQL to find monthly/flex commits and active POCs:

SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, Commit_Type__c, Commit_Start__c, Applied_Ratecard__c, Stage
FROM Opportunity
WHERE Commit_Type__c IN ('monthly','flex')
AND Has_Active_POC__c = TRUE
AND Applied_Ratecard__c LIKE 'v5%'

Export that and run the delta job: /bin/pricing-diff --from v5.2 --to v6.preview --mode "impact" --output csv

omar al-kadi: ops question 1: will the preview require a different regional pricebook import? our APAC billing pipeline has strict validation and it choked last time on new SKU ids.

samir patel: good catch. preview artifacts include regional CSVs that mirror existing SKU id patterns. Still, ops should run validation against the preview schema: use infra/pricebook/validate_schema.py --file apac-preview.csv. If validation fails the importer rejects. Preview S3 path: s3://release-candidate/pricebooks/v6-preview/

dealbot: Release pipeline note: artifacts generated by rp-4107. Files: pricebook-canonical-v6-preview.csv, apac-preview.csv, eu-preview.csv, amendment-template-v6-preview.md, sku-mapping-v6-preview.csv. Tag: rc/v6-preview.

zoe park: deal desk: will stacking rules change? we have a promo that multiplies committed tiers right now and a partner discount additive rule. Any changes break existing deals in the queue.

samir patel: stacking rules intentionally unchanged for preview; we did reword the order and added explicit examples. Rule doc: committed tier -> partner promos -> special credits. If you see a request that needs different math, route to product-pricing for a minor version change (not a preview).

legal-bot: Note: amendment template includes two footers now: one for "opt-in preview" (short form, no term changes) and one for "rate math change" (requires legal review). Use template that matches the customer's ask.

omar al-kadi: quoting system compatibility? last time quotes generated with older pricebook IDs and didn't auto-update.

samir patel: quote engine has a compatibility flag. Run: 

python tools/quote_compat.py --check --ratecard v6-preview --since 2025-02-01 > /tmp/v6-compat.txt

That produces a list. For quotes mid-flow we recommend manual regen and AE confirmation. We will not auto-regenerate without AE opt-in for preview.

zoe park: POCs: can engineering provide an "embeddings-pro" perf blurb (latency and cost) so AEs can sell preview coherently?

samir patel: yes, eng will attach a short one-pager to the artifacts. I asked for perf numbers (avg latency @512 tokens, cost-per-embed at 1M+ vol). Expect that in the artifact bucket by 08:30 PT Mon.

taylor reed: any special handling for partner resellers that lock resale pricing? we have an active reseller in EMEA with a contract clause about SKU changes.

samir patel: we surfaced that to Partnerships. Short answer: contractual reseller protections trump preview changes; partners will get explicit opt-in flow via Partnerships + Legal. If partner requests preview for an account, include partner approval in the amendment.

dealbot: Ops checklist created and attached to release artifacts. Quick checklist highlights: validate regional CSVs, run quote compatibility check, publish amendment templates, notify AE & CS queues, run pricing-diff for top 100 accounts by ARR.

zoe park: thanks. i'll loop deal-desk and AE leads. Can we have a one-line snippet for the external-facing AEs?

samir patel: suggested AE snippet: "v6 preview is an opt-in pricebook introducing embeddings-pro and SKU consolidation; it may change quoted prices for monthly/flex commits so contact deal desk for an amendment if you'd like to opt in."

omar al-kadi: noted. I'll schedule the APAC import validation at Mon 07:15 PT.

samir patel: perfect. flag any blocking POCs here and i'll escalate. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
